findings.title: Duplicate invites under concurrent requests (check-then-insert)
findings.explanation: findFirst and create are not atomic, so two requests can both insert an invite.
findings.evidence: const existing = await db.invite.findFirst({ where: { workspaceId, email } });
findings.trigger: Two invite requests for the same email at once
findings.violatedInvariant: One invite per email and workspace
